svg.title: Counting primes up to 2000
svg.desc: The exact prime-counting staircase and x divided by the natural logarithm of x, with x/log x plotted for 2 ≤ x ≤ 2000.
svg.metadata: Curves generated with GeoGebra Classic JavaScript API; see scripts/generate-landau-figures.cjs.

g.text: π(2000) = 303; 2000 / log 2000 ≈ 263.13. The theorem concerns relative error as x → ∞.
